teams.detail: Dropped the series opener at Tampa Bay 7-2 Friday as the Rays hit four homers, falling to 47-48. Back in action today (Sat 7/11) in game two at Tropicana Field, Logan Gilbert on the mound against Griffin Jax.

Fell to Philadelphia 101-93 in their Summer League opener Thursday; Isaac Jones (22 pts, 4 reb, 2 blk) and No. 17 pick Ebuka Okorie (20 pts, 4 ast, 2 stl) led Detroit. Next: Sunday 7/12, 4 PM ET vs. Cleveland on Prime Video at Thomas & Mack Center.

Franchise sale has narrowed to two bidding groups — one led by 49ers investor Vinod Khosla, the other by Celtics minority owner Aditya Mittal and former Celtics governor Wyc Grousbeck — with a record sale north of $10B possible by August. Training camp opens July 25 in Renton; Zach Charbonnet (torn ACL) has a late-July checkup and is 'progressing well.'

UW is still chasing a cornerback and two offensive linemen after landing Colorado transfer Reis Russell, while RB Jordan Washington continues to target a late-July return from his spring injury. Fall camp is the next major checkpoint before the 2026 opener.

F Hannes Steinbach went 14th overall to the Hornets in June, the 4th-highest German draft pick in NBA history. Danny Sprinkle landed the program's first 2026 signee in local guard Lattimore Ford and continues rebuilding through the portal after losing Zoom Diallo.

headlines.headline: Victor Wembanyama takes less than max on $252M Spurs extension to build around him faster
headlines.detail: Wembanyama and San Antonio agreed to a five-year, $252 million rookie-scale extension — the 25% max tier instead of the 30% supermax that could have paid him $303 million — a deal that could save the Spurs roughly $50 million in cap space over five years. Elsewhere, Cleveland locked up Donovan Mitchell on a four-year, $273 million extension and Memphis traded Ja Morant to Portland.

headlines.headline: Terrion Arnold draws interest from four teams despite felony charges, still unsigned
headlines.detail: The cornerback Detroit released June 29 after his arrest on eight felony charges has now worked out for or drawn inquiries from the Texans, Colts, Jets and Seahawks, per his agent, who says there's a 'very good likelihood' Arnold signs somewhere within 45 days.

headlines.headline: Pac-12 officially back at FBS status as Texas State joins as eighth football member
headlines.detail: Texas State's move from the Sun Belt made the Pac-12 whole again as of July 1, clearing the NCAA's eight-team minimum for FBS status. Elsewhere, ESPN's preseason FPI opened with Ohio State No. 1 and Oregon getting a boost after Dante Moore passed on the NFL draft to return at quarterback.

headlines.headline: St. John's Donnie Freeman out for season as offseason portal chaos tops 2,700 transfers
headlines.detail: Red Storm forward Donnie Freeman will miss all of 2026-27 after rupturing his Achilles in a team workout and undergoing surgery. More than 2,700 players have entered the portal since the season ended — the largest offseason player-movement wave on record — while five-star guard Marcus Spears Jr. reclassified to 2026 to join Texas.
